name: Spiking Labs
description: Spiking Labs builds private AI products for everyday life, made for people, and helps teams put AI to work without giving up their data.

hero.after: of intelligence for everyday life, made for people.
hero.lead: We build private AI products for everyday life, and help teams put AI to work without handing over their data.

principles.title: Private by default
principles.body: Your data stays yours. We prefer on-device storage, self-hosted models and no tracking, and we say so in plain words.

principles.title: Small and composable
principles.body: Focused tools that do one job well and plug into the rest of your stack, instead of one more platform to adopt.

principles.title: Useful over impressive
principles.body: We automate the boring, repetitive parts of life and work. If it does not save someone time, we do not ship it.

cta.title: Got a problem worth solving? Tell us about it.
cta.body: Describe your team and the problem in a few lines. We will get back to you with next steps.
cta.label: Write to us
cta.subject: Let's talk about AI for my business

about.title: A small lab with a bias for shipping.
paragraphs: Our team has a diverse background. We have brought automation, data-driven decision making and machine learning to different industries and to companies of different sizes.
We are ready to create value using our knowledge and experience. Just drop us a message.
